 Order
Date : 12.08.2024
Heard Ms. R. D. Mozumdar, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred impugning the judgment dated 09.07.2019 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Nagaon in MAC Case No. 616/2016 whereby the appellant was directed to pay a compensation amount of Rs.12,35,341/- along with 7% interest per annum thereon to the to the Page No.# 3/3 claimants respondents.
The appeal is admitted.
Call for the case record of MAC Case No. 616/2016 from the concerned Tribunal.
Issue notice to the respondents.
The appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice to the respondents by registered post with A/D as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable after four weeks.
